study: Borman, Pyne, Rozek & Schmidt (2021/2022), AERJ 59(2):284-314 — values-affirmation writing intervention at scale
delivery_evidence: Teachers received a brief ~30-min training prior to implementation plus written materials/script; the publication does not state whether this teacher training was delivered in person or online (p. 'Method', 'teachers received a brief training of approximately 30 minutes prior to implementation').
test_alignment_evidence: The only reported achievement outcome is cumulative GPA from school administrative records (a broad, intervention-independent measure), used as a mediator; coded standardized_independent in extraction (p.21).
curriculum_evidence: Intervention is a brief self-affirmation/values-affirmation writing exercise (3-4 ~15-min activities) delivered as normal classroom activities within existing language-arts/homeroom classes; no new curriculum or instructional-materials package adopted ('distributed intervention materials as if they were normal classroom activities', Method).
outcome_timing_evidence: Intervention delivered in grade 7; the GPA achievement outcome is cumulative across grades 7-8, so it spans the intervention year (immediate) and the year after (delayed) ('cumulative postintervention GPA', p.21).
